title: First Day Questionnaire
instructions: Provide answers to the following questions. Readjust the text box size as needed

questions.prompt: What degree are you aiming for?  What other GDAMG courses have you taken?
What previous or other education have you had (it can be any field or area, not just games)?
Why are you taking this class?
What do you hope to learn from this class? Is there anything not planned for this course that you would like to learn?
What is your dream job or career, and why?
Have you worked at a games, software, or entertainment company before? If so, where?
Where do you see yourself in 5 years? What will you be doing?
What game dev tools are you familiar with? Do you have any prior coding experience?
What are your hobbies, and what do you do for fun?
What would you like me to know about yourself?
What do you want to know about me (I'll answer these in class.)?
